name: Tame All Creatures
description: Lets you tame and befriend ALL creatures; zombies, mi-go, robots, nether beings, everything.  Adds craftable taming treats, pacification bombs that deploy big visible gas clouds to daze monsters for easier taming, healing incense clouds to patch up your tamed creatures, command items, a corpse-to-treat conversion toolkit, 8 new taming-focused professions, custom starting scenarios with tamed pets, and a Wandering Tamer NPC with quests that teach advanced recipes.  Preserves vanilla faction relationships so untamed creatures still behave naturally, craftable creature armor in two tiers (simple and reinforced) for 15 different body types, mountable large creatures, silent tamed creatures, profession morale bonuses, and a biosignature system that lets tamed creatures produce useful drops over time when tied down.
